title: Ahora — describí lo que está pasando
goals: Meta declarada por el material: decir qué están haciendo, qué llevan puesto y cómo se ven las personas, y recomendar películas.
Aprendé a describir a alguien de arriba abajo y a contrastar lo que hace ahora con lo que hace siempre.
Cerrá describiendo a alguien en una foto, en 120 palabras.

atoms.prompt: Choose a picture of a person doing an activity. Describe who the person is, what he or she looks like and what he or she is wearing. Comment what the person is doing and contrast it with what he or she generally does. Imagine what type of film he or she likes. About 120 words.
atoms.modelAnswer: This is a photo of my friend Martín. He is in his late twenties and he works as a maths teacher. He is tall and well-built, and he has got short curly dark hair, brown eyes and a short beard. In the photo he is wearing a grey hoodie, blue jeans and black trainers. He is sitting on the floor of his living room and he is playing the guitar. This is unusual for him, because he normally spends his free time reading or correcting exams. I think he likes science fiction films, because he loves stories about the future and other planets. His favourite one is Star Wars.
modelVariants: This is my aunt Clara. She is in her early sixties and she is retired. She is of medium height and slim, and she has got short grey hair and glasses. In the photo she is wearing a long blue skirt, a white blouse and a red cardigan. She is standing in her garden and she is watering the plants. She does this every morning, so it is not unusual at all. I think she likes romantic comedies, because she always says that a film has to end well.
scaffold: 1. Quién es y a qué se dedica.
2. La edad, con la fórmula del material (in his late twenties).
3. Cómo se ve: altura, complexión, pelo, ojos.
4. Qué está usando EN LA FOTO (is wearing).
5. Qué está haciendo (is doing) y EL CONTRASTE con lo que hace en general (normally does).
6. Qué películas le gustan, y por qué.
